# HVAControl Inc.

HVAControl Inc. is a family-run heating, air conditioning, and general building shop in Granada Hills, California.
We repair and install air conditioners and furnaces for homes and small businesses.
We service all major brands of heating and cooling equipment.
We offer maintenance agreements that keep comfort equipment tuned.
We design systems and install humidification and electronic air cleaners.
Since 2016 we also build single-family homes, ADUs, and garage conversions.
We serve Granada Hills, Porter Ranch, Northridge, North Hills, Van Nuys, West Hills, the San Fernando Valley, and greater Los Angeles.
Our shop is at 17735 San Fernando Mission Boulevard, Granada Hills, CA 91344.
Our licence is CA Lic #922478 B, C-20, and we are licensed, bonded, and insured.
Call us at (877) 877-9487 or email hvacontrol@yahoo.com to schedule a visit.
Our website is https://www.hvacontrol.net/
